side_policy: Near-frontal initial image-left shoulder/hip is depicted right, image-right is left. Follow bare shoulder/forearm chains through crossed arms and the later profile pose; raised near-side arm is tracked as left, not renamed by current wrist x. Premirror actor side is uncertified.

tracks.reason: Hands leave the waist and visible forearms fold across the upper torso; no exact3D degree amount is claimed.
Crossed wrists descend toward the waist as arms separate, relative to the current shoulders/torso rather than body imageY alone.
Extended overhead forearm folds toward the head; contact with hair/head itself is not a new measured fact.

unknown_channel_reason: Hands held around hips, small finger rotations, torso/hip sway and crossed/hidden forearm endpoints do not certify3D wrist/angle reversals. Shoe/leg shifts and bends are real but loose trousers, low-angle perspective and hip motion leave side-resolved exact knee/ankle3D quantities uncertain. Root/yaw/depth/radial values and ground contact remain uncalibrated; unknown is not stillness.

other_observed_source_motion.description: Repeated hip/torso sway with foot lifting/return and knee/leg silhouette changes throughout0–68, followed by profile posture; these are not deleted or converted into world displacement/force or knee cycles from shoe height.
